extracted.name: Slow-Baked Beef Brisket with Gravy
extracted.description: This tender beef brisket, smothered in mushroom gravy, is so easy to make. Everything goes into the baking dish and cooks in the oven, low and slow.
ingredient_lines: 1 teaspoon unseasoned meat tenderizer (such as Adolph's®)
1 (1 ounce) package dry onion soup mix
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 275 degrees F (135 degrees C). Season beef brisket with garlic salt and meat tenderizer; place in a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Mix beef gravy, Italian salad dressing, mushrooms, and onion soup mix in a bowl. Pour mixture over beef brisket. Cover tightly with aluminum foil.
Bake in the preheated oven until very tender, 4 to 5 hours.
